title: Coefficientwise base change of generation and fraction maps on scheme tests
statement: Let F,G be presheaves on S-schemes, f:F→h_T and f′:G→h_T′, and k:G→F, g:T′→T a commutative square. Let A,A′ be affine-basis graded algebras, D coefficientwise graded pullback data along g [lemma-nagata-relative-proj-base-change-arbitrary], L a coherent cartesian line family on F-tests and ψ,ψ′ compatible graded line maps, where ψ′ uses L.pullback k and compatibility is IsBaseChange [def-trf-space-line-module-proj-input]. For every G-test W, the generation set of ψ′ equals that of ψ on the composite F-test. Moreover, if W is generating and q:W→Proj_T(A), q′:W→Proj_T′(A′) satisfy their respective IsCanonicalTestMap predicates [lem-trf-space-line-test-map], then q′ followed by D.relProjComparison equals q. No algebraic-space assumption on F or G and no flatness are required.

source.place: Tag 0D2Z, opening generation locus and part (3); Constructions Tags 01NK and 01O9.

proof.text: Refine a test by affine opens above compatible affine opens of both bases and choose a local frame. Graded base change writes primed homogeneous sections as finite sums of scalar multiples of coefficient images of unprimed sections. The IsBaseChange equation and linearity identify their scalar images. In the same local ring these images generate the unit ideal precisely when at least one unprimed positive-degree image is a unit. This proves equality of the generation sets without any flatness assumption.

source.place: Tag 0D2Z, opening generation locus and part (3); Constructions Tags 01NK and 01O9.

proof.text: On a generating test the corresponding generator opens cover. In the local Proj chart, D sends b/a^m to D(b)/D(a)^m. The canonical-test formulas send both to the same scalar fraction by coefficient compatibility. All elements of the degree-zero localization have homogeneous fraction representatives, so affine adjunction proves equality on each chart. The relative-Proj comparison identities and scheme morphism gluing give q′;D.relProjComparison=q.

theorem space_line_test_base_change {S : Scheme.{u}}
    {F G : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} {T T' : Over S}
    {f : F ⟶ yoneda.obj T} {f' : G ⟶ yoneda.obj T'}
    {A : T.left.GradedAlgebraData} {A' : T'.left.GradedAlgebraData}
    {L : TestLineFamily F} (hL : L.IsCoherent) (ψ : GradedLineMap f A L)
    (k : G ⟶ F) (g : T' ⟶ T)
    (hcomm : k ≫ f = f' ≫ yoneda.map g)
    (D : Scheme.GradedAlgebraData.PullbackData g.left A A')
    (ψ' : GradedLineMap f' A' (L.pullback k)) (hψ' : ψ.IsBaseChange k g D ψ') :
    (∀ W : SchemeTests G,
      ψ'.generationSet W = ψ.generationSet ((CostructuredArrow.map k).obj W)) ∧
    ∀ (W : SchemeTests G) (hW : ψ'.generationSet W = Set.univ)
      (q : W.left ⟶ projOver T A) (q' : W.left ⟶ projOver T' A'),
      ψ.IsCanonicalTestMap ((CostructuredArrow.map k).obj W) q →
      ψ'.IsCanonicalTestMap W q' → q'.left ≫ D.relProjComparison = q.left
